role.en: Software Engineer focused on Backend, Infrastructure & Deployment Systems
role.id: Software Engineer dengan fokus Backend, Infrastruktur & Deployment Systems

headline.en: I build the layer between software and where it actually runs.
headline.id: Saya membangun penghubung antara software dan tempat ia benar-benar berjalan.

summary.en: I work across backend systems, infrastructure, deployment automation, and technical integration. My strongest projects come from turning messy operational constraints into software that can be deployed, observed, recovered, and handed off clearly.
summary.id: Saya bekerja di area backend, infrastruktur, otomasi deployment, dan integrasi teknis. Proyek terkuat saya lahir dari mengubah constraint operasional yang berantakan menjadi software yang bisa dideploy, diamati, dipulihkan, dan di-handoff dengan jelas.

availability.en: Open to early-career FDE, Solutions Architecture, Backend, and DevOps opportunities
availability.id: Terbuka untuk peluang early-career FDE, Solutions Architecture, Backend, dan DevOps

education.en: Bachelor of Computer Engineering (S.T.), Universitas Negeri Semarang, 2026
education.id: Sarjana Teknik Komputer (S.T.), Universitas Negeri Semarang, 2026

proof.en: independent runs per objective in current ACC experiments
proof.id: independent run per objective pada eksperimen ACC saat ini

description.en: APIs, databases, authentication, real-time communication, service boundaries, and operational workflows.
description.id: API, database, autentikasi, komunikasi real-time, batas antar-service, dan workflow operasional.

description.en: Linux, containers, reverse proxies, DNS, deployment automation, runtime exposure, and recovery-oriented delivery.
description.id: Linux, container, reverse proxy, DNS, otomasi deployment, runtime exposure, dan delivery yang berorientasi recovery.

description.en: Translate operational pain points into deployable systems, debug across boundaries, and keep the handoff understandable.
description.id: Menerjemahkan pain point operasional menjadi sistem yang bisa dideploy, melakukan debugging lintas boundary, dan menjaga handoff tetap mudah dipahami.

description.en: Experiment pipelines, model evaluation, optimization studies, evidence-oriented AI workflows, and careful capability boundaries.
description.id: Experiment pipeline, evaluasi model, studi optimasi, workflow AI berbasis evidence, dan batas kemampuan yang dijelaskan secara hati-hati.

description.en: A deployment is not finished when it starts. Logs, health, state, rollback, and failure boundaries should remain inspectable.
description.id: Deployment belum selesai hanya karena berhasil start. Log, health, state, rollback, dan failure boundary harus tetap bisa diperiksa.

description.en: Network access, client environments, ownership, and team workflow matter as much as the application code.
description.id: Akses jaringan, environment client, ownership, dan workflow tim sama pentingnya dengan application code.

title.en: Leave a system others can operate
title.id: Tinggalkan sistem yang bisa dioperasikan orang lain

description.en: Prefer explicit configuration, predictable recovery, and documentation over cleverness that only survives in the author’s head.
description.id: Utamakan konfigurasi eksplisit, recovery yang predictable, dan dokumentasi daripada kecerdikan yang hanya hidup di kepala pembuatnya.

toolkit.items: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, REST APIs, WebSocket, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma, SQLAlchemy
Linux, Docker, Podman, Compose, NGINX, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS, Gitea, GitHub Actions
Health checks, logs, deployment state, rollback/LKG patterns, blue-green concepts, runtime exposure
Model evaluation, optimization experiments, evidence pipelines, Gemini workflows, MinIO, ESP32 integration
